card.title: Supportive Rage
card.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Good catch. Take my clean shirt. I am absolutely furious, but you are not tackling this alone.

mechanism: A keeps providing practical cleanup help as damage and personal loss intensify the anger.
confusable: Unlike disguising hostility as politeness, A must remain genuinely useful and encouraging while fury grows.
comparison: D21-a sacrifices a shirt to repair damage; D21-b pays and arranges a wished-for lunch while counting mounting losses.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
